hook.line: Most businesses think SEO, AEO and GEO are the same. They're not.
hook.visual: Giant white 'AEO' slams across the frame then shrinks into a top title 'SEO ≠ AEO ≠ GEO' over a man with a lav mic against a night skyline.

beats.what: Oversized 'AEO' wipes in and resolves into the 'SEO ≠ AEO ≠ GEO' title by 1.5 s
Defines SEO: ranking in traditional search engines
Defines AEO: becoming the direct answer in AI Overviews
Defines GEO: getting AI platforms to understand, trust, cite and recommend you
Stakes: only doing SEO in 2026 misses where customers search
Series promise: next videos break down each one
Follow ask for daily SEO and AI tips

why_it_works: Calls out a common belief and denies it in under 7 s, so viewers stay to see the difference
The '≠' title is a three-item list promise in the first frame, giving a clear structure to wait through
Series promise ('next few videos') gives a concrete reason to follow, right before the follow ask
weaknesses: Single 53 s shot with no cuts or cutaways; the three definitions all look the same on screen
No visual per term (no icon, logo or highlight for SEO vs AEO vs GEO) to make the comparison stick
Brand names are mangled in captions, which hurts credibility
Definitions stay abstract with no example result
for_robert: Steal the big-word slam that shrinks into a locked title, then give each list item its own beat: Fred swaps a sign for SEO, AEO and GEO as each is defined.
